title: Patrick Mahomes Revealed Chiefs' Head Coach Andy Reid Threaten To Bench Anyone Who Watched Rihanna Performance [Watch]
htmlContent:
On February 12, 2023, the Super Bowl halftime show was electrified by a stunning performance by none other than Rihanna. The Barbadian singer brought the house down with her hit songs and impeccable dance moves, leaving the audience in awe. However, that was not the only surprise Rihanna had in store for her fans.

After finishing her final song, Rihanna took the microphone and announced to the world that she is pregnant once again. The crowd erupted into cheers and applause as the singer shared the news of her upcoming bundle of joy.

This announcement comes after months of speculation about Rihanna's possible pregnancy. Rumors had been circulating for a while, and fans had been eagerly waiting for the official confirmation. Many were delighted to hear the news and congratulated the singer on her growing family.

Rihanna's pregnancy marks an exciting new chapter in her life, and fans are eagerly awaiting any updates on the upcoming arrival. This will be her second child, as she already has a daughter with her partner, A$AP Rocky.

The news of Rihanna's pregnancy also comes at a time when there is growing discussion around the representation of pregnant women in mainstream media. With her bold announcement, Rihanna is helping to break down stigmas and norms around pregnancy, showcasing that it is possible to be a successful and powerful woman while also embracing motherhood.

Overall, Rihanna's Super Bowl performance and subsequent pregnancy announcement have been causing celebration from fans around the world. As she prepares to embark on this exciting new chapter of her life, it is clear that Rihanna will continue to be a force to be reckoned with, both in her personal life and career. Regenerate response.

However, Patrick Mahomes said Not a Kansas City Chiefs were included in the hundred million people who caught Rihanna's halftime show on Sunday.

Mahomes unveiled on Monday that Andy Reid threatened to bench anyone that left the locker room.

The quarterback star told Jimmy Kimmel on "Jimmy Kimmel Live" that his head coach was very serious in his conversation with the team about this, too.

"Coach Reid told us, he said, 'If you go out to watch the performance, just keep walking,'" Mahomes said, "'because you're not playing the rest of the game.'"
